Job Purpose

The PostgreSQL Database Lead / Senior Database Developer owns the design, build and performance of the database layer for a large‑scale, multi‑tenant, cloud‑native SaaS platform. The role suits an engineer who has built transactional systems where data accuracy, auditability and tenant isolation are non‑negotiable.

The role holder makes foundational data architecture decisions on a greenfield platform and takes them through to production. They work closely with solution architects, backend engineers, data and AI engineers, DevOps and security teams, and set database standards while guiding other developers.

Technical Skills

  • 6+ years of database development experience, with at least 5 years focused on PostgreSQL and 2+ years in a lead or senior role.
  • Proven experience as a database lead or senior developer on large‑scale, multi‑tenant SaaS applications in the cloud.
  • In‑depth knowledge of PostgreSQL architecture and internals.
  • Expert SQL and PL/pgSQL programming, including complex queries, functions and stored procedures.
  • Strong data modelling skills across normalized transactional schemas, especially financial or ledger data.
  • Expertise in performance tuning: query optimisation, indexing, partitioning.
  • Hands‑on experience implementing multi‑tenant isolation (row‑level security).
  • Designing and operating highly available PostgreSQL: replication, failover, backup/recovery, point‑in‑time recovery, disaster recovery.
  • Experience with managed PostgreSQL services on a major cloud platform, preferably Azure.
  • Working knowledge of connection pooling and connection management.
  • Managing version‑controlled schema migrations through CI/CD pipelines.
  • Scripting in Python and/or shell for automation and monitoring.
  • Solid understanding of database security: access control, encryption, auditing, protection of personal and financial data.
  • End‑to‑end ownership of the data layer, balancing architecture with delivery speed.
  • Leadership: set standards, run design reviews, mentor developers.
  • Diagnose complex performance and data‑integrity issues methodically.
  • Communicate trade‑offs clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Good to Have

  • Experience with Azure cloud services.
  • Supporting analytics, reporting or AI data workloads.
  • Scaling PostgreSQL for high data volumes.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code and DevOps practices.
  • Exposure to Node.js‑based applications.
  • Experience in accounting, fintech or other financial software.
  • Exposure to security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Translate business and non‑functional requirements into database designs with measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Design PostgreSQL solutions meeting targets for performance, scalability, availability, security and recoverability.
  • Define data models, schemas, constraints and configurations that protect data integrity.
  • Design financial and transactional data models, including immutable audit trails and precise monetary handling.
  • Define multi‑tenant isolation strategy (row‑level security, tenant‑aware partitioning) and prevent cross‑tenant access.
  • Design for data residency, retention and multi‑region deployment where required.
  • Build and maintain tables, indexes, views, functions, stored procedures and triggers.
  • Analyse execution plans and optimise queries, indexing, partitioning and configuration.
  • Ensure correctness under concurrency via appropriate isolation levels, locking strategies and idempotent processing.
  • Design reliable data integration patterns (transactional outbox, idempotent ingestion).
  • Plan and run data migration, transformation and loading with validation and reconciliation.
  • Design storage and retrieval for AI features (vector embeddings) while maintaining tenant isolation.
  • Enable change data capture and replication to analytics/ML platforms without degrading transactional performance.
  • Support data quality, lineage and protection of sensitive data for analytics and AI workloads.
  • Work with cloud operations and DevOps to design, implement and test high availability and disaster recovery against agreed RTO/RPO targets.
  • Define and regularly test backup, restore and point‑in‑time recovery procedures.
  • Monitor performance, investigate bottlenecks and concurrency issues, lead root‑cause analysis and remediation.
  • Run capacity planning and validate scalability under expected and peak workloads.
  • Implement least‑privilege access, encryption at rest and in transit, and database auditing.
  • Provide controls and evidence for privacy regulations and audit frameworks.
  • Manage schema changes as version‑controlled code delivered through CI/CD with migration testing, rollback plans and zero‑downtime deployment.
  • Establish database development standards, review designs and code, and mentor developers.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation for data models, procedures and operational runbooks.
  • Adhere to Information Security Management policies and procedures.

Qualifications / Experience

  • Degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline, or equivalent combination of education, certifications and work experience.
summary: Lead PostgreSQL architect designs, builds, and optimizes multi‑tenant SaaS databases, ensuring performance, security, and compliance. Provides technical leadership and mentors developers across the platform.
